Amumu.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle early to survive, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Amumu deals mostly magic damage, and Karthus has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Avoid relying on a large health increase alone to deal with Amumu W Despair.
Amumu.combo: Place Karthus W Wall of Pain in Amumu’s escape route, then drop Karthus Q Lay Waste on the far side of the wall. If he gets close, activate Karthus E Defile and cast Karthus Q Lay Waste under him, aiming for a spot where he doesn’t overlap a minion.
Amumu.escape: Wait for Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy to be used before stepping forward. Amumu has no ability to create distance on his own, so place Karthus W Wall of Pain across his escape route and pressure him with Karthus Q Lay Waste.
Amumu.fight: While Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy are available, keep your distance and deal damage with Karthus Q Lay Waste. After Amumu uses his engage ability, place Karthus W Wall of Pain across his escape route and look for Karthus Q Lay Waste. If you have to fight at close range, activate Karthus E Defile, but turn it off as soon as Amumu leaves its range.
Amumu.laning: For trades, hit Amumu with Karthus Q Lay Waste when he isn’t overlapping a minion to maximize its single-target damage. When farming, use Karthus Q Lay Waste on overlapping targets and secure the last hits yourself to restore mana.
Amumu.phase: Farm safely and join early pressure where possible before Amumu gets Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy. In the mid game, affect the entire map with Karthus R Requiem. In late-game teamfights, Karthus P Death Defied lets you keep dealing damage after you die.
Amumu.teamfight: While Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is available, spread out from your team, avoid narrow passages, and keep casting Karthus Q Lay Waste from the back line. When Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is used, look for an opportunity to start a fight and cast Karthus R Requiem from a safe position. If you die, avoid being too far from the enemy and keep dealing damage with Karthus E Defile and Karthus Q Lay Waste during Karthus P Death Defied.
Amumu.watch: If Amumu Q Bandage Toss hits you, it stuns you and lets Amumu close the gap, so move unpredictably with minions or jungle monsters between you. While Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is available, stay spread out from your team and keep your distance in open terrain. Once Amumu gets close, Amumu W Despair keeps dealing damage based on your max health, so don’t stay near him for long.

Belveth.build: Bel'Veth's main damage is physical, and Karthus has low armor, so start with Cloth Armor and build armor first. Choose Plated Steelcaps for boots, and move up Zhonya's Hourglass to prepare for engages from Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet. Remember that armor can't stop the magic damage from Bel'Veth W Above and Below or the true damage from Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet.
Belveth.combo: Place Karthus W Wall of Pain where Bel'Veth must step on her escape route, then cast Karthus Q Lay Waste on her after she passes through the wall. If the melee fight continues, turn on Karthus E Defile and cast Karthus Q Lay Waste where Bel'Veth doesn't overlap with minions; turn off Karthus E Defile once you create distance.
Belveth.escape: Dodge Bel'Veth W Above and Below, and look for an opening before Bel'Veth Q Void Surge comes back up. Bel'Veth Q Void Surge has a separate cooldown for each direction, so position Karthus Q Lay Waste based on the direction she just dashed from. Bel'Veth's mobility ability comes back quickly, so don't engage deeply just because one charge is down.
Belveth.fight: Dodge Bel'Veth W Above and Below to the side. Once her pursuit slows, place Karthus W Wall of Pain where Bel'Veth will step and aim Karthus Q Lay Waste. If Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom is active, focus your damage after it ends. In close fights, turn on Karthus E Defile and cast Karthus Q Lay Waste at your feet, but turn off Karthus E Defile if Bel'Veth moves away.
Belveth.laning: When trading, target Bel'Veth with Karthus Q Lay Waste where she doesn't overlap with minions; in camps, cast Karthus Q Lay Waste where monsters overlap.
Belveth.phase: Stacks from Bel'Veth P Death in Lavender last permanently, making her harder to deal with as time passes, so don't give up your early advantage.
Belveth.teamfight: Keep casting Karthus Q Lay Waste from the back and position yourself to die as late as possible. Cast Karthus R Requiem from a safe spot where you can protect the channel. If Bel'Veth gets a Void Coral after helping kill one of your allies, move away from that spot and delay the teamfight during the transformation. If Karthus P Death Defied triggers, deal damage with Karthus E Defile and Karthus Q Lay Waste near the enemy team; if Karthus R Requiem is ready and the enemy team's health has been reduced, use it to finish them off.
Belveth.watch: When Bel'Veth closes in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, don't just run straight backward; cut sideways to dodge the knockup from Bel'Veth W Above and Below. Bel'Veth takes greatly reduced damage during Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom, so don't rush Karthus Q Lay Waste or Karthus R Requiem.

Brand.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Brand deals mostly magic damage, and Karthus has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Brand P Blaze deals damage based on max health, so don’t rely on building health alone.
Brand.combo: Place Karthus W Wall of Pain along Brand’s retreat path, then drop Karthus Q Lay Waste on him as he crosses it. If you end up fighting at close range, activate Karthus E Defile and cast Karthus Q Lay Waste under Brand, then turn Karthus E Defile off once he creates distance.
Brand.escape: Use the moment Brand W Pillar of Flame is used as your chance to engage. If Brand P Blaze is applied to you, first dodge the stun from Brand Q Sear, then close the distance after the fire goes out. Brand has no mobility ability, so once you’re close, pressure his escape route with Karthus W Wall of Pain.
Brand.fight: Close the distance when Brand W Pillar of Flame is used and Brand P Blaze isn’t applied. Brand has no mobility ability, so place Karthus W Wall of Pain across his escape route and hit the slowed Brand with Karthus Q Lay Waste. If you’re burning and could be stunned by Brand Q Sear, dodge the projectile first.
Brand.laning: Don’t last-hit beside burning minions, and step aside when the wave is clustered. If Brand remains in range right after using a poke ability, trade with Karthus W Wall of Pain and Karthus Q Lay Waste. When targeting Brand with Karthus Q Lay Waste, aim where he doesn’t overlap a minion to maximize its single-target damage.
Brand.phase: Early on, Karthus has no escape and Brand’s ability combos are dangerous, so play carefully and dodge his first attack. In the mid game, Karthus R Requiem and ability power core items let you affect the entire map. In late-game teamfights, Karthus P Death Defied lets you keep dealing damage after you die, but cast Karthus Q Lay Waste for as long as possible while alive.
Brand.teamfight: Spread out from your team to prevent Brand E Conflagration from spreading and Brand R Pyroclasm from bouncing, and don’t stand beside burning allies. Deal damage with Karthus Q Lay Waste from the back line. If the enemy frontline engages on your team, activate Karthus E Defile to deal area damage. Even if you die, stay close to the enemy team and use Karthus E Defile and Karthus Q Lay Waste during Karthus P Death Defied. If the enemy team is low and Karthus R Requiem is available, finish them from spirit form.
Brand.watch: After Brand P Blaze is applied, getting hit by another ability increases the damage from its stacks, so avoid his first attack. In particular, Brand Q Sear stuns you while you’re burning, so dodge the projectile or hide behind a minion. When you see Brand W Pillar of Flame, move out of its marked area, and watch for Brand E Conflagration spreading from burning minions nearby.

Briar.build: Briar deals mostly physical damage, and Karthus has low armor, so start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps. Her engage can interrupt Karthus R Requiem’s channel, so prioritize Zhonya's Hourglass earlier. If the duel runs long, consider anti-healing after building armor.
Briar.combo: Place Karthus W Wall of Pain in Briar’s path, then drop Karthus Q Lay Waste where she’ll be after crossing the wall. If the fight becomes close-range, activate Karthus E Defile and cast Karthus Q Lay Waste under Briar. Turn Karthus E Defile off when she moves away.
Briar.escape: Don’t go in just because Briar Q Head Rush is used. Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack and Briar R Certain Death are also mobility tools, so check which abilities remain and look especially for an opening before Briar R Certain Death comes back up. Karthus still has no escape, so engage only after an ally has immobilized Briar or when she has a long escape route.
Briar.fight: Briar has many ways to engage, and Karthus can’t escape on his own, so keep your distance when starting a fight. Place Karthus W Wall of Pain where Briar will pass, then hit the slowed Briar with Karthus Q Lay Waste without overlapping a minion. If she gets close, activate Karthus E Defile and cast Karthus Q Lay Waste under her, but turn Karthus E Defile off immediately if she moves away.
Briar.laning: Don’t stand in the middle of the lane for long without vision. Push the lane, then establish vision to create a position where you can punish Briar’s reckless engage. Karthus has difficulty setting up ganks on his own, so go in only after an ally has immobilized the target or when the enemy has a long escape route. Otherwise, keep farming and use Karthus W Wall of Pain to help your allies engage.
Briar.phase: Briar tends to have high kill participation early, and Karthus has no escape, so focus on vision and managing your distance. From the mid game onward, Karthus R Requiem and his ability power core items let him affect the entire map, so check other lanes for the right time to use it. In late-game teamfights, Karthus P Death Defied lets you keep dealing damage after you die.
Briar.teamfight: Keep casting Karthus Q Lay Waste from behind your frontline, and position yourself so you aren’t the first target of Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack or Briar R Certain Death. Cast Karthus R Requiem from a safe position where you can protect its channel. If the entire enemy frontline has engaged on your team, activate Karthus E Defile and move in to deal area damage. Even if you die, stay near the enemy team and keep using Karthus E Defile and Karthus Q Lay Waste during Karthus P Death Defied.
Briar.watch: Briar Q Head Rush dashes in, stuns, and reduces resistances, so first make sure she can’t reach you. When Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack sends her charging in, she chases the nearest enemy, so stay behind your frontline. If Briar E Chilling Scream starts charging, move away from walls. If Briar R Certain Death marks you as its prey, move toward your team so you can face her together.

Diana.build: Diana deals mostly magic damage, and Karthus has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Buy Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Prioritize Zhonya's Hourglass earlier to prepare for Diana E Lunar Rush diving in.
Diana.combo: Place Karthus W Wall of Pain where Diana will pass, then drop Karthus Q Lay Waste behind the slowed Diana. For trades, aim Karthus Q Lay Waste where she doesn’t overlap a minion to maximize its single-target damage. If Diana gets close, activate Karthus E Defile and cast Karthus Q Lay Waste under her, then turn Karthus E Defile off once she creates distance.
Diana.escape: Look for an opening right after Diana uses E Lunar Rush without a Q Crescent Strike mark. Diana E Lunar Rush won’t reset in this case, so slow her with Karthus W Wall of Pain and attack with Karthus Q Lay Waste. If you’re marked, create distance instead of treating it as an opening.
Diana.fight: Start trading after the spheres and shield from Diana W Pale Cascade disappear. If Diana engages first with E Lunar Rush without using Q Crescent Strike, slow her with Karthus W Wall of Pain and look for Karthus Q Lay Waste. If Diana Q Crescent Strike marks you, create distance instead of trying to engage her.
Diana.laning: Karthus also has no escape, so watch out for the enemy jungler’s engage.
Diana.phase: In the mid game, Karthus R Requiem and ability power core items let you affect the entire map. In late-game teamfights, Karthus P Death Defied lets you keep dealing damage after you die.
Diana.teamfight: Use vision to watch for Diana coming in from the flank, and spread out from your team so Diana R Moonfall can’t pull several of you in at once. Keep casting Karthus Q Lay Waste from the back line and position yourself to die as late as possible. If you die, use Karthus E Defile and Karthus Q Lay Waste on the enemy team during Karthus P Death Defied. If the enemy team, including Diana, is low and Karthus R Requiem is available, look to finish them.
Diana.watch: Diana Q Crescent Strike curves as it travels and applies a mark. Dodge sideways instead of retreating in a straight line. If it hits you, Diana can engage repeatedly with Diana E Lunar Rush, so create distance. In teamfights, spread out so Diana R Moonfall can’t pull several allies in at once.

Ekko.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Ekko deals mostly magic damage, and Karthus has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Prioritize Zhonya's Hourglass earlier to prepare for Ekko E Phase Dive closing the distance.
Ekko.combo: Place Karthus W Wall of Pain where Ekko will pass, then drop Karthus Q Lay Waste behind the slowed Ekko, whose magic resistance is reduced. If Ekko closes in with E Phase Dive, activate Karthus E Defile and hit him with Karthus Q Lay Waste where he doesn’t overlap a minion.
Ekko.escape: Avoid the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence and stay outside its stun range, then look to fight after Ekko E Phase Dive and Ekko W Parallel Convergence are used. If Ekko R Chronobreak is still available, don’t chase deep just because Ekko E Phase Dive is used. The best opening is especially before Ekko R Chronobreak comes back up.
Ekko.fight: Trade from the back line with Karthus Q Lay Waste while avoiding Ekko W Parallel Convergence’s area. If Ekko closes in with E Phase Dive, activate Karthus E Defile and drop Karthus Q Lay Waste under him, but turn Karthus E Defile off immediately if he moves away. When Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, don’t chase just because he’s low on health.
Ekko.laning: For trades, target Ekko with Karthus Q Lay Waste when he doesn’t overlap a minion. When farming, use it where minions overlap. Keep Karthus E Defile on only while Ekko is close to save mana.
Ekko.phase: Early on, Karthus has no escape, so watch for Ekko’s engage while farming. In the mid game, Karthus R Requiem and ability power core items let you affect other lanes. In late-game teamfights, Karthus P Death Defied lets you keep dealing damage after you die.
Ekko.teamfight: Keep casting Karthus Q Lay Waste from the back line and avoid any area where you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence. While Ekko is within Karthus E Defile’s range, activate it to deal damage. If you die, make the most of Karthus P Death Defied’s ability use time from a position near the enemy team. Cast Karthus R Requiem from a safe position where Ekko can’t interrupt its channel with his engage; you can also use it in spirit form.
Ekko.watch: When you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, stay out of its area to avoid the stun and shield. Step away from the return path of Ekko Q Timewinder. If you see the afterimage from Ekko R Chronobreak, don’t chase recklessly even if he is low on health.

Elise.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle to withstand Elise’s magic damage early, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. If Elise jumps in, Karthus can’t escape with a mobility ability, so prioritize Zhonya's Hourglass earlier.
Elise.combo: Place Karthus W Wall of Pain where Elise must pass on her escape route, then drop Karthus Q Lay Waste behind the wall. If Elise gets close, keep Karthus E Defile on and cast Karthus Q Lay Waste under her, aiming for a spot where she doesn’t overlap a minion.
Elise.escape: Once you confirm both Elise E Rappel and Elise E Cocoon are used, look for a chance to turn on her. If she goes airborne with Elise E Rappel, place Karthus Q Lay Waste at her landing spot in advance, then pressure her escape route with Karthus W Wall of Pain after she lands.
Elise.fight: Engage after both Elise E Cocoon and Elise E Rappel are used. Place Karthus W Wall of Pain where Elise will pass to slow her and reduce her magic resistance, then deal damage with Karthus Q Lay Waste. Activate Karthus E Defile only when she’s close, and turn it off immediately if she moves away.
Elise.laning: Secure plenty of vision early, and don’t push the lane recklessly while Elise is missing. Stand behind minions to avoid Elise E Cocoon, and grow stronger by clearing camps with Karthus Q Lay Waste and Karthus E Defile.
Elise.phase: Watch for Elise’s ganks early, avoid giving up kills, and collect camps and waves. In the mid game, use Karthus R Requiem and ability power core items to affect the entire map. In late-game teamfights, Karthus P Death Defied lets you keep dealing damage after you die.
Elise.teamfight: Keep dropping Karthus Q Lay Waste from the back line and position yourself to die as late as possible. While Elise can still engage, cast Karthus R Requiem from a safe position. If you die, stay near the enemy team and deal damage with Karthus E Defile and Karthus Q Lay Waste during Karthus P Death Defied. If Karthus R Requiem is available, finish off low-health enemies.
Elise.watch: Watch out for Elise Q Neurotoxin while you’re healthy. After your health is reduced, watch for Elise to transform with R Spider Form and try to finish you.

Evelynn.build: Evelynn deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first and choose Null-Magic Mantle and Mercury's Treads early. Prioritize Zhonya's Hourglass earlier to prepare for Evelynn E Whiplash diving in. Consider Banshee's Veil if you need to protect Karthus R Requiem’s channel.
Evelynn.combo: Place Karthus W Wall of Pain along Evelynn’s escape route, then drop Karthus Q Lay Waste where she’ll pass through the wall. If Evelynn gets close, activate Karthus E Defile and cast Karthus Q Lay Waste under her, aiming for a spot where she doesn’t overlap nearby units. Turn Karthus E Defile off immediately if Evelynn moves out of range.
Evelynn.escape: When Evelynn W Allure marks you, don’t engage; retreat before the charm lands. Don’t chase just because Evelynn E Whiplash is used. Look for an opening after Evelynn R Last Caress is also used. Karthus has difficulty setting up an engage on his own, so join only after an ally has immobilized Evelynn or when she has a long escape route.
Evelynn.fight: Before the mark from Evelynn W Allure matures, retreat and drop Karthus Q Lay Waste in her expected engage path. For a safe trade, place Karthus W Wall of Pain where Evelynn will pass, then hit her with Karthus Q Lay Waste after the slow and magic resistance reduction. Use Evelynn R Last Caress being used as an opening to attack, but check that Evelynn E Whiplash is used too before going in.
Evelynn.laning: Early on, Karthus has no escape, so secure vision and collect camps and waves. Carry a Control Ward, and place regular wards where Evelynn will start fighting her own jungle camps. If you can win before level 6, invade Evelynn’s jungle to delay her reaching level 6.
Evelynn.phase: From the mid game onward, Karthus R Requiem lets you affect the entire map, but retreat first when you see the mark from Evelynn W Allure. In the late game, Karthus P Death Defied lets you keep dealing damage after you die.
Evelynn.teamfight: Deal damage with Karthus Q Lay Waste from within an area covered by your team’s vision, and watch for Evelynn coming in from behind. If Evelynn engages, place Karthus W Wall of Pain where she’ll pass to slow her, then deal damage with Karthus Q Lay Waste and Karthus E Defile. Cast Karthus R Requiem from a safe position where you can finish channeling. If you die, keep dealing damage with Karthus E Defile, Karthus Q Lay Waste, and Karthus R Requiem if available during Karthus P Death Defied.
Evelynn.watch: When you see the mark from Evelynn W Allure, she’s already nearby preparing her charm. Retreat into your team’s vision before the mark matures and alert your allies. Evelynn E Whiplash after the charm deals damage based on max health and dashes in, so avoid taking it in narrow paths. When your health is low, watch out for the increased damage from Evelynn R Last Caress.

Fiddlesticks.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle early to withstand Fiddlesticks’ magic damage, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Prioritize Zhonya's Hourglass earlier since Fiddlesticks can dive in with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm.
Fiddlesticks.combo: Place Karthus W Wall of Pain along Fiddlesticks’ escape route, then drop Karthus Q Lay Waste where he passes the wall. When fighting at close range, activate Karthus E Defile and cast Karthus Q Lay Waste under him, aiming for Fiddlesticks when he doesn’t overlap a minion. Turn Karthus E Defile off immediately when he leaves its range.
Fiddlesticks.escape: Look for an opening while Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm is down. After confirming Fiddlesticks Q Terrify and Fiddlesticks E Reap are down as well, approach while slowing his retreat with Karthus W Wall of Pain.
Fiddlesticks.fight: If Fiddlesticks Q Terrify and Fiddlesticks E Reap hit you, you’re likely to get hit by Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm next, so keep your distance first. While Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm is down, slow his retreat with Karthus W Wall of Pain and hit him with Karthus Q Lay Waste. If Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest starts, don’t stay in its area to continue the fight.
Fiddlesticks.laning: A stationary Scarecrow Effigy could be the real Fiddlesticks, so don’t walk past it until you’ve checked. Rather than forcing a gank, clear camps and waves, and engage only when an ally has already caught the enemy or they have a long escape route.
Fiddlesticks.phase: From the mid game onward, Karthus R Requiem lets you affect the entire map, but watch out for ambushes with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm. In the late game, Karthus P Death Defied lets you keep dealing damage after you die, so choose your teamfight position carefully.
Fiddlesticks.teamfight: Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest, Fiddlesticks E Reap, and Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm all deal area damage, so spread out from your allies and don’t group in narrow terrain. Keep casting Karthus Q Lay Waste from the back line, and move out of range when Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm comes in. Cast Karthus R Requiem from a safe position where you can protect its channel. Even after you die, keep dealing damage with Karthus E Defile and Karthus Q Lay Waste during Karthus P Death Defied.
Fiddlesticks.watch: If Fiddlesticks disappears from vision for a long time, he may prepare Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm from a brush, so avoid narrow passages without vision. If you see him cast it, slow him with Karthus W Wall of Pain to interrupt it; if you can’t interrupt it, move out of range. Also watch out for the fear from abilities that hit from out of vision and the silence from Fiddlesticks E Reap.

Gragas.build: Gragas mainly deals magic damage, and Karthus has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Survive the early game with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Since Gragas E Body Slam can catch you, prioritize Zhonya's Hourglass as well.
Gragas.combo: When Gragas E Body Slam is down, place Karthus W Wall of Pain along his escape route, then drop Karthus Q Lay Waste behind Gragas as he crosses the wall. If you end up fighting at close range, activate Karthus E Defile and stack Q at your feet, but turn E off when Gragas moves away.
Gragas.escape: Right after baiting out Gragas E Body Slam is Karthus's chance to close the distance. Do not go in while E is still available, and even after it is down, move clear of Gragas Q Barrel Roll's radius. Chase a fleeing Gragas only when you can secure the kill.
Gragas.fight: Fight outside Gragas E Body Slam's range, and save your burst while Gragas W Drunken Rage is reducing his damage taken. Right after Gragas uses E, place Karthus W Wall of Pain across his escape route and look for a hit with Karthus Q Lay Waste. Hit Gragas with Q when he is not overlapping with minions to maximize single-target damage.
Gragas.laning: Early on, prioritize keeping your distance, since getting caught once by Gragas E Body Slam makes it easy for him to follow up. Do not stay where Gragas Q Barrel Roll is placed, and keep Karthus E Defile on only while Gragas is in range. When the fight ends, turn E off immediately and last-hit directly to recover mana.
Gragas.phase: Early on, watch out for Gragas's burst and engage while managing your distance and mana. In the mid game, use Karthus R Requiem to influence fights in other areas, but cast it from a safe spot where you can finish channeling. If you hold your formation in early- and mid-game objective fights against Gragas, the matchup becomes more favorable for Karthus as the game goes on.
Gragas.teamfight: Keep casting Karthus Q Lay Waste from the backline, and do not stand alone where Gragas E Body Slam can reach you. Use Karthus R Requiem from a safe position or when an ally can protect your channel. If all enemy frontline champions have engaged on your allies, activate Karthus E Defile and go in; if you die there, keep dealing damage with E and Q in Karthus P Death Defied.
Gragas.watch: When you see Gragas Q Barrel Roll, move outside its radius before it explodes. If Gragas E Body Slam hits you near the cask, you can easily get hit by both abilities, so watch the range of E and paths without vision. When Gragas has R Explosive Cask available, do not stand with the enemy formation or a turret at your back.

Graves.build: Graves deals mostly physical damage, and Karthus has relatively low armor, so build armor first. Survive the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Graves can dash in with Graves E Quickdraw and Graves R Collateral Damage, so prioritize Zhonya's Hourglass as well.
Graves.combo: Place Karthus W Wall of Pain along Graves's escape route, then drop Karthus Q Lay Waste beyond the wall. In close fights, activate Karthus E Defile and cast Karthus Q Lay Waste at your feet; turn Karthus E Defile off when the distance opens up.
Graves.escape: The opening comes after the slow from Graves W Smoke Screen wears off and Graves uses Graves E Quickdraw. Graves R Collateral Damage is also a movement tool, so do not go deep just because Graves E Quickdraw is down. Especially before Graves R Collateral Damage comes back up, slow his escape with Karthus W Wall of Pain and look for a hit with Karthus Q Lay Waste.
Graves.fight: Counterattack or create distance while Graves reloads after firing two shots. Place Karthus W Wall of Pain along Graves's escape route, then drop Karthus Q Lay Waste where he is not overlapping with minions to maximize single-target damage. If Graves gets close, activate Karthus E Defile and cast Karthus Q Lay Waste at your feet, but turn Karthus E Defile off immediately when he moves away.
Graves.laning: When fighting, keep a minion between you and Graves to block Graves P New Destiny's basic attacks. When using Karthus Q Lay Waste to hit only Graves, aim for a spot where he is not overlapping with minions.
Graves.phase: Early Karthus has no escape and is easy to catch, so push waves and limit the time Graves has to build his growth stacks, but be careful when approaching. In the mid game, Karthus R Requiem and your AP core items can influence the whole map. Graves gets stronger as he builds stacks, making him harder to deal with over time, so early pressure is important.
Graves.teamfight: Keep casting Karthus Q Lay Waste from behind, with an ally or unit between you and Graves to block Graves P New Destiny's basic attacks. Use Karthus R Requiem from a safe spot where Graves cannot interrupt your channel by engaging. If the enemy frontline has engaged on your allies, activate Karthus E Defile to deal area damage; if you die, keep using Karthus E Defile and Karthus Q Lay Waste during Karthus P Death Defied, and look to finish enemies with Karthus R Requiem.
Graves.watch: Graves Q End of the Line explodes immediately when it hits terrain, so do not fight with a wall at your back or in a narrow path. If you get caught in Graves W Smoke Screen, leave its area by the shortest route to regain vision and movement speed. Graves P New Destiny's basic attack is blocked by the first unit it hits, so fight with a minion or ally between you and him.

Hecarim.build: Survive the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Hecarim deals mostly physical damage, so build armor first. His engage can interrupt Karthus R Requiem, so prioritize Zhonya's Hourglass as well.
Hecarim.combo: Place Karthus W Wall of Pain along Hecarim's approach to slow him and reduce his magic resistance, then hit him with Karthus Q Lay Waste. If Hecarim is already on top of you, activate Karthus E Defile and drop Karthus Q Lay Waste at your feet. Turn Karthus E Defile off as soon as Hecarim moves out of range.
Hecarim.escape: Do not engage just because Hecarim E Devastating Charge is down. Fight only after Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows is also down, or especially before it comes back up. Karthus has no movement ability to escape with, so check your distance from allies before going in.
Hecarim.fight: When Hecarim charges in, make him cross Karthus W Wall of Pain first to reduce his approach speed and attack damage. Keep your distance and hit Hecarim with Karthus Q Lay Waste when he is not overlapping with minions.
Hecarim.laning: Karthus struggles to gank alone, so only go in when an ally has already caught an enemy or the enemy has a long escape route. Otherwise, farm camps and waves, and save mana by keeping Karthus E Defile on only as long as needed.
Hecarim.phase: In the mid game, use Karthus R Requiem and your AP core items to influence fights elsewhere on the map. In late-game teamfights, Karthus P Death Defied lets you keep dealing damage after you die, but position so you die as late as possible.
Hecarim.teamfight: Spread out from your allies to avoid being feared together by Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows, and keep hitting him with Karthus Q Lay Waste from behind. When Hecarim engages, slow him with Karthus W Wall of Pain and avoid fighting for long inside Hecarim W Spirit of Dread. If you are going to die, stay close to enemies and deal damage with Karthus E Defile and Karthus Q Lay Waste during Karthus P Death Defied. Use Karthus R Requiem from a safe spot where you can finish channeling; you can also use it after you die.
Hecarim.watch: Hecarim E Devastating Charge deals more damage and knocks back farther the farther he has run, so when he turns and starts charging, move close to an ally or break vision. Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows can fear multiple enemies, so spread out from your allies.

Ivern.build: Survive the early game with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Ivern's damage is mostly magic, but the real threat is his allies following up on his root and knock-up, so tenacity matters too. If Ivern's allies can jump onto Karthus, prioritize Zhonya's Hourglass.
Ivern.combo: When Ivern Q Rootcaller is down, place Karthus W Wall of Pain along Ivern's escape route and drop Karthus Q Lay Waste where he will cross the wall. In close fights, activate Karthus E Defile and cast Karthus Q Lay Waste at your feet, but target Ivern when he is not overlapping with minions.
Ivern.escape: Bait out Ivern Q Rootcaller and dodge it; that is your chance to close the distance. If Ivern E Triggerseed is already on a target, wait for its imminent slow to detonate before approaching.
Ivern.fight: Karthus has no ability to escape on his own, so first keep enough distance to dodge Ivern Q Rootcaller. Right after Ivern Q Rootcaller is down, place Karthus W Wall of Pain along the escape route and drop Karthus Q Lay Waste to trade. Approach a target affected by Ivern E Triggerseed after the shield detonates.
Ivern.laning: Early on, keep minions or terrain between you and Ivern to deny Ivern Q Rootcaller an angle, and do not casually walk past newly created Ivern W Brushmaker. Karthus should join fights when an ally has already immobilized an enemy or the enemy has pushed far in and has a long escape route; otherwise, farm camps and waves. Keep Karthus E Defile on only while enemies are close, and turn it off when they move away.
Ivern.phase: Early Karthus has no escape, so he is easy to catch with Ivern Q Rootcaller and his allies following up; keep your distance and maintain jungle vision. In the mid game, use Karthus R Requiem and your AP core items to influence the whole map, and in late-game teamfights, Karthus P Death Defied lets you keep dealing damage after you die.
Ivern.teamfight: Keep dropping Karthus Q Lay Waste from behind, and account for the chance that it will hit Ivern R Daisy! when she is in front of enemies you are targeting. Do not overcommit to chasing an enemy affected by Ivern E Triggerseed; fight after the shield detonates. Cast Karthus R Requiem from a safe spot, and even if you die, continue using Karthus E Defile and Karthus Q Lay Waste near the enemy team during Karthus P Death Defied.
Ivern.watch: If Ivern Q Rootcaller hits you, Ivern's allies can dash toward the rooted target, so keep minions or terrain between you and Ivern and maintain distance before he casts it. If you move toward a target affected by Ivern E Triggerseed, you are likely to get caught by the slow when it detonates. If Ivern R Daisy! starts hitting you repeatedly, reposition to avoid being knocked up.

JarvanIV.laning: When targeting a champion with Karthus Q Lay Waste, choose a spot where they are not overlapping with minions to maximize single-target damage.
JarvanIV.teamfight: Keep casting Karthus Q Lay Waste from behind and position so you die as late as possible. If you die inside the enemy team, use Karthus E Defile and Karthus Q Lay Waste during Karthus P Death Defied; if Karthus R Requiem is still available and enemies have lost health, use it to finish them.

Jax.build: If Jax closes in with Jax Q Leap Strike, Karthus is in danger because he has no mobility, so prioritize Zhonya's Hourglass. Jax deals both physical and magic damage, so avoid building resistance to only one type; also avoid stacking only health, considering the max-health-based damage from Jax E Counter Strike.
Jax.combo: After moving outside Jax E Counter Strike's stun range, place Karthus W Wall of Pain where Jax will cross it, then drop Karthus Q Lay Waste on his slowed position. While Jax is on top of you, activate Karthus E Defile and cast Karthus Q Lay Waste at your feet, aiming where he is not overlapping with minions. Turn Karthus E Defile off immediately when the distance opens up.
Jax.escape: The windows to apply pressure are right after Jax uses Jax Q Leap Strike and after Jax E Counter Strike ends. Karthus has no mobility, so do not go in while Jax E Counter Strike is active; slow him with Karthus W Wall of Pain, then fight within range of Karthus Q Lay Waste.
Jax.fight: Jax E Counter Strike does not block ability damage, so respond with Karthus Q Lay Waste and Karthus E Defile, but do not stay in its stun range. Trade briefly after Jax Q Leap Strike and Jax E Counter Strike are down. Avoid extended face-to-face fights while Jax P Relentless Assault boosts his attack speed.
Jax.laning: Do not stand close to a pack of allied minions, and check which minions Jax can use as stepping stones for Jax Q Leap Strike.
Jax.phase: In the mid game, Jax R Grandmaster-at-Arms and his first core item increase his fighting power, while Karthus can also influence the whole map with Karthus R Requiem and AP core items. In the late game, Karthus P Death Defied lets you keep dealing damage after you die, so prioritize your teamfight positioning.
Jax.teamfight: When Jax engages with Jax Q Leap Strike, avoid clumping together and dodge the area-of-effect stun from Jax E Counter Strike. Keep casting Karthus Q Lay Waste from behind, then focus your ability damage after Jax E Counter Strike ends. Use Karthus R Requiem from a safe position where Jax E Counter Strike cannot interrupt your channel; if you die, use Karthus E Defile and Karthus Q Lay Waste during Karthus P Death Defied.
Jax.watch: Jax Q Leap Strike can use minions or wards as stepping stones, so do not give him engage range around them. When Jax E Counter Strike is active, stop basic attacking and move outside its area-of-effect stun range.

Kayn.build: Survive first with Cloth Armor and build armor; choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Prioritize Zhonya's Hourglass to prepare for Kayn's engage. If Kayn transforms into his Rhaast form and keeps healing, consider Grievous Wounds after building resistances.
Kayn.combo: Place Karthus W Wall of Pain along Kayn's escape route, then drop Karthus Q Lay Waste behind him as he crosses the wall. If Kayn gets close, activate Karthus E Defile and hit him with Q where he is not overlapping with minions; turn E off when the distance opens up.
Kayn.escape: Do not engage just because Kayn Q Reaping Slash is down. Dodge Kayn W Blade's Reach and start a fight before Kayn R Umbral Trespass comes back up, after checking his remaining movement abilities.
Kayn.fight: Dodge Kayn W Blade's Reach and look to fight before Kayn R Umbral Trespass comes back up. If Kayn gets close, activate Karthus E Defile and drop Karthus Q Lay Waste at Kayn's feet when he is not overlapping with minions. Turn E off immediately when Kayn moves away.
Kayn.laning: Pressure camps and objectives while Kayn is weak before transforming, but use Karthus Q and E to clear the jungle and do not keep farming camps recklessly when your mana drops below half. Join ganks when an ally has already immobilized an enemy or the enemy has a long escape route.
Kayn.phase: In the mid game, use Karthus R Requiem and AP core items to influence the whole map; in late-game teamfights, Karthus P Death Defied lets you keep dealing damage after you die.
Kayn.teamfight: Keep casting Karthus Q Lay Waste from behind, and use Karthus R Requiem when you can channel safely. If Kayn R Umbral Trespass enters an ally, prepare for where Kayn will emerge around the target. If you are going to die, stay close to the enemy team and deal damage with E Defile and Q Lay Waste during Karthus P Death Defied; if enemies have lost health and R is still available, use it.
Kayn.watch: Dodge the line skillshot from Kayn W Blade's Reach to reduce the chance of his engage leading into Kayn R Umbral Trespass from range. When the warning for Kayn E Shadow Step appears along a wall's edge, stop trading and retreat toward your turret.

Khazix.build: Kha'Zix deals mostly physical damage, and Karthus has low armor, so start by surviving with Cloth Armor. Choose Plated Steelcaps for boots, and prioritize Zhonya's Hourglass to prepare for Kha'Zix E Leap engaging on you.
Khazix.combo: When Kha'Zix E Leap is down, place Karthus W Wall of Pain along the escape route and drop Karthus Q Lay Waste beyond the wall where the slowed Kha'Zix will cross. While Kha'Zix is close, activate Karthus E Defile and cast Karthus Q Lay Waste at your feet; turn Karthus E Defile off immediately when the distance opens up.
Khazix.fight: Avoid being isolated by staying near allies or minions, and counterattack right after Kha'Zix E Leap is down. Place Karthus W Wall of Pain where Kha'Zix will cross it and hit him with Karthus Q Lay Waste, aiming where he is not overlapping with minions to maximize single-target damage.
Khazix.phase: In the mid game, Karthus R Requiem can influence the whole map, but stop acting alone once Kha'Zix has two or more evolutions. In late-game teamfights, Karthus P Death Defied lets you keep dealing damage after you die.
Khazix.teamfight: Group with allies in a narrow area where you have vision to avoid the isolation damage from Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear, and keep dropping Karthus Q Lay Waste from behind. Kha'Zix can interrupt Karthus R Requiem, so use it from a safe position or under an ally's protection. Even if you die, use the duration of Karthus P Death Defied near enemies for Karthus E Defile and Karthus Q Lay Waste; if Karthus R Requiem is still available and enemies have lost health, use it to finish them.
Khazix.watch: Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear deals much more damage when you are isolated, so stay near allies or minions. If Kha'Zix closes in with Kha'Zix E Leap or becomes invisible with Kha'Zix R Void Assault, cast Karthus Q Lay Waste along his expected approach path and target the moment he reappears.
Khazix.laning: Early on, avoid letting Kha'Zix figure out where you are alone, and keep the river and jungle entrance brushes warded. In jungle camps, cast Karthus Q Lay Waste where the monsters overlap and turn on Karthus E Defile to clear them, but don’t keep taking camps recklessly if your mana drops below half.
Khazix.escape: Right after Kha'Zix uses Kha'Zix E Leap to engage is your chance to create distance or counterattack, so slow his path with Karthus W Wall of Pain and hit him with Karthus Q Lay Waste. If Kha'Zix E Leap is evolved and an ally has helped secure a takedown, it may be available again, so do not count on that window.

Kindred.build: Kindred's main damage is physical, and Karthus has low armor, so buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps. Kindred can engage with Kindred Q Dance of Arrows and Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy, so get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier too.
Kindred.combo: Place Karthus W Wall of Pain where Kindred must cross on the escape route, then drop Karthus Q Lay Waste where Kindred emerges from the wall. In close fights, turn on Karthus E Defile and hit Kindred with Karthus Q Lay Waste where Kindred isn't overlapping another unit. Turn off Karthus E Defile once distance opens up.
Kindred.escape: Look to engage when both Kindred Q Dance of Arrows and Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy are down, especially before Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy comes back. If the slow from Kindred E Mounting Dread is down too, fight while using Karthus W Wall of Pain to slow Kindred's escape.
Kindred.fight: Don't start a fight just because Kindred Q Dance of Arrows is down; look for a window before Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy comes back as well. Use Karthus W Wall of Pain to cover Kindred's escape route, then hit the slowed Kindred with Karthus Q Lay Waste.
Kindred.laning: Secure vision early to track Kindred's pathing. Take marked camps first or ward nearby to delay Kindred from collecting marks. Clear camps with Karthus E Defile and Karthus Q Lay Waste, but don't force the next camp if your mana drops below half.
Kindred.phase: In the mid game, Karthus R Requiem and ability power core items let you affect fights elsewhere on the map. In late-game teamfights, use Karthus P Death Defied to keep dealing damage after you die.
Kindred.teamfight: Keep casting Karthus Q Lay Waste from the back, and use Karthus R Requiem, which requires channeling, only from a safe position. When Kindred R Lamb's Respite is active, enter the zone to benefit from its protection and the healing when it ends. If all of the enemy frontline has engaged on your allies, turn on Karthus E Defile and move in. Even if you die, keep dealing damage with Karthus E Defile and Karthus Q Lay Waste through Karthus P Death Defied near the enemy team.
Kindred.watch: If Kindred E Mounting Dread is applied, create distance or break line of sight to avoid follow-up attacks. Its damage is more dangerous at low health, and Kindred can repeatedly cast Kindred Q Dance of Arrows to chase you inside Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy, so don't stay there long.

LeeSin.build: Early on, buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps. Lee Sin's main damage is physical, and Karthus has low armor, so build armor first. Get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier too since Lee Sin can engage on you.
LeeSin.combo: After Lee Sin engages, place Karthus W Wall of Pain where he must cross, then drop Karthus Q Lay Waste along his slowed path. If he gets close, keep Karthus E Defile on and cast Karthus Q Lay Waste at his feet, aiming for a spot where he isn't overlapping minions. Turn off Karthus E Defile as soon as the fight ends.
LeeSin.escape: Don't engage just because Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike is down. Focus your damage when that ability is still down and Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will has also been used to engage. If Lee Sin still has an engage tool available, keep your distance and use Karthus W Wall of Pain to slow his path.
LeeSin.fight: Avoid dueling Lee Sin early, and look for an opening when Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike misses or is down. Once Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will has also been used to engage, use Karthus W Wall of Pain to cover his escape route and hit him with Karthus Q Lay Waste. Keep Karthus E Defile on only while he is close, and turn it off immediately when he backs away.
LeeSin.laning: Join ganks when an ally has already immobilized the enemy or the enemy has pushed the lane deep. Otherwise, use Karthus W Wall of Pain to cover the escape route and help your allies engage.
LeeSin.phase: Lee Sin is strong in early duels, and Karthus has no escape, so it's better to back off. In the mid game, Karthus R Requiem and ability power core items let you start affecting the entire map. In the late game, Karthus can deal damage after dying with Karthus P Death Defied, so farm camps and waves to buy time until then.
LeeSin.teamfight: Keep casting Karthus Q Lay Waste from the back. Stand with a wall or your frontline behind you to deny Lee Sin space to get behind you, while keeping some distance from your allies. Cast Karthus R Requiem from a safe spot where you can maintain the channel; if it's hard to cast while alive, you can use it during Karthus P Death Defied. If the entire frontline has engaged on your allies, turn on Karthus E Defile and move in. If you die, keep dealing damage with Karthus E Defile and Karthus Q Lay Waste near the enemy team.
LeeSin.watch: Lee Sin can come over walls into areas without your vision using Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will, so stand away from walls.

Lillia.build: Lillia deals mostly magic damage, and Karthus has relatively low magic resistance, so buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads. Get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier as well to prepare for Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! engaging on you.
Lillia.combo: Place Karthus W Wall of Pain where Lillia must pass on her escape route, then drop Karthus Q Lay Waste beyond the wall. Once Lillia crosses it, she is slowed and loses magic resistance, making her easier to hit with Q. If Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! gets her on top of you, turn on Karthus E Defile and place Karthus Q Lay Waste at her feet, then turn off Karthus E Defile when distance opens up.
Lillia.escape: Right after making Lillia use Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! is your chance to close the distance or cut her off. Dodge Lillia's abilities to clear her movement speed stacks, then use Karthus W Wall of Pain to slow her escape. If you are hit by Lillia R Lilting Lullaby, don't engage; move away during the drowsy window.
Lillia.fight: Avoid Lillia's abilities so she can't build movement speed stacks, then fight. In trades, hit Lillia with Karthus Q Lay Waste when she isn't overlapping a minion to maximize its single-target damage. If you end up fighting up close, turn on Karthus E Defile and drop Karthus Q Lay Waste at her feet, then turn off Karthus E Defile when distance opens up.
Lillia.laning: When farming, cast Karthus Q Lay Waste where minions or monsters overlap, and keep Karthus E Defile on only as long as needed. Join ganks when an ally has already immobilized the enemy or the enemy has pushed deep, leaving a long escape route.
Lillia.phase: In the mid game, Karthus R Requiem and ability power core items let you affect the entire map. In late-game teamfights, use Karthus P Death Defied to keep dealing ability damage after you die.
Lillia.teamfight: Keep casting Karthus Q Lay Waste from the back and position yourself to die as late as possible. Save one of your allies' immobilizing effects to catch Lillia when she flanks. If all of the enemy frontline has engaged on your allies, turn on Karthus E Defile and move in. Keep dealing damage with E and Q after you die, and finish with Karthus R Requiem if enemies have lost health.
Lillia.watch: Getting hit by Lillia Q Blooming Blows or Lillia E Swirlseed enables Lillia R Lilting Lullaby to put you to sleep, so dodge them even at high health. If you see Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! begin, move sideways to avoid the center. If you are hit by her ultimate, move to safety during the drowsy window before you fall asleep.

MasterYi.build: Master Yi's main damage is physical, and Karthus has low armor, so buy Cloth Armor first to survive and choose Plated Steelcaps. Get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier to prepare for Master Yi Q Alpha Strike engaging on you. Master Yi E Wuju Style deals true damage that armor can't reduce, so build health too.
MasterYi.combo: Once Master Yi Q Alpha Strike ends and he lands, place Karthus W Wall of Pain where he must cross on his escape route, then drop Karthus Q Lay Waste beyond the wall. If Master Yi gets close, turn on Karthus E Defile and cast Karthus Q Lay Waste at his feet, aiming for a spot where he isn't overlapping minions. Turn off Karthus E Defile as soon as Master Yi leaves its range.
MasterYi.escape: Right after making Master Yi use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike is your window to close the distance. While Master Yi R Highlander is active, Karthus W Wall of Pain's slow can't create distance, so engage only when your allies have immobilizing crowd control available.
MasterYi.fight: Right after Master Yi uses Master Yi Q Alpha Strike is your chance to close the distance or cut him off. In trades, hit Master Yi with Karthus Q Lay Waste when he isn't overlapping a minion, and keep Karthus E Defile on only while he is close. Karthus can't apply immobilizing crowd control immediately, so engage when an ally has already caught Master Yi.
MasterYi.laning: Keep Karthus E Defile on only while Master Yi is close, and don't force another camp if your mana drops below half. If an opportunity comes up to stop Master Yi's early growth, don't delay taking the objective.
MasterYi.phase: Karthus can affect the entire map from the mid game onward, once Karthus R Requiem and his core ability power items come online, so take early objective opportunities while farming. Master Yi gets stronger as the game goes longer, but Karthus can still deal ability damage after dying in the late game.
MasterYi.teamfight: Keep casting Karthus Q Lay Waste from the back and position yourself to die as late as possible. Use Karthus R Requiem when you can protect its channel. If Master Yi gets a takedown, he can quickly stick to his next target, so group up to keep allies from getting caught alone. Use your allies' immobilizing crowd control to interrupt Master Yi W Meditate as well. If Karthus dies, keep dealing damage with Karthus E Defile and Karthus Q Lay Waste near the enemy; if Karthus R Requiem is still available and enemies have lost health, use it.
MasterYi.watch: Master Yi Q Alpha Strike is a movement ability, and Master Yi can't be targeted while casting it, so look for him right after he lands. When Master Yi R Highlander is active, his movement and attack speed increase and slows don't work, so you can't rely on Karthus W Wall of Pain alone to create distance. Watch out for the true damage from Master Yi E Wuju Style as well.

MonkeyKing.build: Early on, buy Cloth Armor to survive and choose Plated Steelcaps. Wukong deals mostly physical damage, so build armor first, but keep in mind that Wukong Q Crushing Blow reduces that armor and Wukong E Nimbus Strike's magic damage isn't blocked by it. Get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier since Wukong can engage on you.
MonkeyKing.combo: Place Karthus W Wall of Pain where Wukong must pass on his escape route, then drop Karthus Q Lay Waste behind the real champion after he crosses the wall. If Wukong gets close, turn on Karthus E Defile and cast Karthus Q Lay Waste at his feet, aiming for a spot where he isn't overlapping minions. Turn off Karthus E Defile as soon as the fight ends.
MonkeyKing.escape: Wait until Wukong W Warrior Trickster is down, then check whether he has also used Wukong E Nimbus Strike before engaging. If only one mobility tool is down, he can escape with the other, so don't chase carelessly. Right after Wukong R Cyclone is down, look for a chance to force a fight or take an objective.
MonkeyKing.fight: Wukong builds armor and healing the longer he stays in a fight, so keep trades short. When he gets close, trade back with Karthus E Defile and Karthus Q Lay Waste to exploit his low magic resistance, but turn off Karthus E Defile when Wukong moves away. Don't waste abilities on Wukong W Warrior Trickster's clone; identify the real champion.
MonkeyKing.laning: Position yourself outside Wukong E Nimbus Strike's range. When trading with Karthus Q Lay Waste, aim for Wukong when he isn't overlapping a minion. When farming, do the opposite: cast Karthus Q Lay Waste where enemy units overlap and last-hit directly to restore mana.
MonkeyKing.phase: In the mid game, Karthus R Requiem and ability power core items let you affect the entire map. In late-game teamfights, position yourself to die as late as possible and use Karthus P Death Defied's damage window if you die.
MonkeyKing.teamfight: If Wukong R Cyclone is available, spread out from your allies, and keep casting Karthus Q Lay Waste from the back. Use Karthus R Requiem from a safe position where Wukong can't interrupt the channel by engaging. If the frontline has engaged on your allies, turn on Karthus E Defile to deal area damage. Even after dying, use Karthus E Defile and Karthus Q Lay Waste during Karthus P Death Defied.
MonkeyKing.watch: Wukong E Nimbus Strike is a targeted dash, so it can't be dodged within range, and the follow-up Wukong Q Crushing Blow reduces your armor. After Wukong W Warrior Trickster, watch the direction of the stealthed champion's movement rather than the clone left in place.

Nidalee.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads. Nidalee deals mostly magic damage, and Karthus has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier too to prepare for Nidalee W Bushwhack / Pounce engaging on you.
Nidalee.combo: When Nidalee W Bushwhack / Pounce is down, place Karthus W Wall of Pain on her escape route and drop Karthus Q Lay Waste beyond the wall. If Nidalee gets close, turn on Karthus E Defile and cast Karthus Q Lay Waste at her feet. In trades, target Nidalee with Karthus Q Lay Waste when she isn't overlapping a minion to maximize its single-target damage.
Nidalee.escape: Right after making Nidalee use Nidalee W Bushwhack / Pounce is your chance to close the distance or cut her off. Nidalee has no crowd control, so look for this opportunity after dodging her spears and traps.
Nidalee.fight: Choose fights after dodging Nidalee Q Javelin Toss and Nidalee W Bushwhack / Pounce traps. Right after Nidalee uses Nidalee W Bushwhack / Pounce, place Karthus W Wall of Pain on her escape route and look for a hit with Karthus Q Lay Waste. If she gets close, turn on Karthus E Defile and turn it off as soon as she moves away.
Nidalee.laning: Check for traps on jungle entrances and in the river with a Control Ward or area abilities before entering. Join ganks only if an ally has already caught the enemy or the enemy has pushed deep, leaving a long escape route; otherwise, farm camps and waves.
Nidalee.phase: Early on, Karthus is easy for the enemy jungler to catch because he has no escape, so safely farm camps and waves. Karthus can affect the entire map from the mid game onward, once Karthus R Requiem and his ability power core items come online, and he can keep dealing damage after dying in the late game. Ask your allies about fights in other lanes to find the right time to use Karthus R Requiem.
Nidalee.teamfight: Keep casting Karthus Q Lay Waste from the back, and dodge Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from long range with your frontline between you and Nidalee. Watch for Nidalee W Bushwhack / Pounce to engage, and use Karthus R Requiem from a safe position. If you die, keep dealing damage with Karthus E Defile and Karthus Q Lay Waste during Karthus P Death Defied. If Karthus R Requiem is still available and enemies have lost health, use it to finish them.
Nidalee.watch: Nidalee Q Javelin Toss deals heavy damage from long range, so dodge it with minions or your frontline between you and Nidalee. Watch for Nidalee W Bushwhack / Pounce traps on jungle entrances and in the river. If you get hit by a spear or trap, be ready for Nidalee to close in with Nidalee W Bushwhack / Pounce and use Nidalee Q Javelin Toss / Takedown.

Nocturne.build: Use Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Nocturne deals mostly physical damage, and Karthus has low armor, so build armor first. Move up Zhonya's Hourglass because Nocturne can dive in with Nocturne R Paranoia.
Nocturne.combo: If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is active, break the spell shield first with Karthus Q Lay Waste. Then place Karthus W Wall of Pain where Nocturne will pass and cast Karthus Q Lay Waste on the other side of the wall. If Nocturne is close, turn on Karthus E Defile and cast Karthus Q Lay Waste at your feet.
Nocturne.escape: After breaking the tether from Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror, face him once the fear is avoided with Karthus W Wall of Pain and Karthus Q Lay Waste. If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is down, you can cast Karthus W Wall of Pain first without worrying about it being blocked.
Nocturne.fight: If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is ready, break the spell shield first with Karthus Q Lay Waste, then place Karthus W Wall of Pain. If Nocturne gets close, turn on Karthus E Defile and cast Karthus Q Lay Waste at your feet, aiming for a spot that doesn't overlap with minions. Turn off Karthus E Defile when the fight ends or Nocturne leaves its range.
Nocturne.laning: Clear camps and waves with Karthus Q Lay Waste and Karthus E Defile, but don't force another camp if your mana drops below half. Last-hit enemy units directly to get mana back from Karthus E Defile.
Nocturne.phase: Early on, Karthus has no escape, so farm cautiously and watch for Nocturne's approach. In the mid game, Karthus can affect the whole map with Karthus R Requiem and core ability power items, but don't start channeling where Nocturne R Paranoia can reach you. In late-game teamfights, Karthus can still deal damage after dying with Karthus P Death Defied.
Nocturne.teamfight: When Nocturne R Paranoia darkens your screen, don't scatter; move toward your allies. Keep casting Karthus Q Lay Waste from the back, and cast Karthus R Requiem from a safe spot where Nocturne's engage can't interrupt the channel. If you die after being reduced to very little health, use Karthus E Defile and Karthus Q Lay Waste in spirit form with Karthus P Death Defied near the enemy team, then finish them off with Karthus R Requiem if they have lost health and your ultimate is ready.
Nocturne.watch: When Nocturne R Paranoia darkens your screen, immediately move toward your allies. If Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror connects, create distance to break the tether before the fear triggers. If you're hit by Nocturne Q Duskbringer, don't run straight along its trail; angle toward your allies or a turret.

Nunu.build: Nunu & Willump deals mostly magic damage, and Karthus has relatively low magic resistance, so buy Null-Magic Mantle first. Choose Mercury's Treads for magic resistance and tenacity. If Nunu & Willump Q Consume's healing makes it hard to finish them, get Morellonomicon early.
Nunu.combo: When Nunu & Willump's crowd control is down, place Karthus W Wall of Pain where they must cross on their escape route, then hit the slowed Nunu & Willump with Q Lay Waste. When damaging the champion, aim for a spot where they aren't overlapping minions to maximize Karthus Q Lay Waste's single-target damage. In close fights, turn on E Defile and drop Q Lay Waste at their feet, then turn off E Defile immediately when distance opens up.
Nunu.escape: Your chance to engage comes after Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! misses and you dodge the root from E Snowball Barrage. Nunu & Willump has no ability to create distance, so use Karthus W Wall of Pain to pressure their movement and keep casting Q Lay Waste. When Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero begins, Karthus has no immobilizing ability to interrupt it, so leave its range.
Nunu.fight: Karthus has no ability to escape on his own, so first stay out of range of Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! and E Snowball Barrage. Once both abilities' crowd control is down, place Karthus W Wall of Pain where Nunu & Willump must cross and trade with Karthus Q Lay Waste. Nunu & Willump can heal with Nunu & Willump Q Consume, so don't assume one trade will be enough to finish them.
Nunu.laning: Keep managing your distance even after one gank, since Nunu & Willump can come right back after taking the scuttle crab. In jungle camps, cast Karthus Q Lay Waste where monsters overlap and turn on Karthus E Defile to clear them, but don't force another camp if your mana drops below half.
Nunu.phase: In the mid game, Karthus R Requiem and ability power core items let you affect the entire map, so watch for fights in other lanes while farming camps and waves. In late-game teamfights, keep fighting from a position where you can die as late as possible, since Karthus can still deal ability damage after dying.
Nunu.teamfight: Keep hitting enemies with Karthus Q Lay Waste from the back, and leave the range when Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero begins. Use Karthus R Requiem from a safe position where Nunu & Willump's crowd control can't interrupt it. If the frontline engages on your allies and Karthus can move in, use E Defile to deal area damage. If you die, use E Defile and Q Lay Waste near the enemy team during P Death Defied, and use R Requiem to finish them as well.
Nunu.watch: Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! rolls in from far away and knocks Karthus up, so watch for it as soon as it rolls in from beyond river vision. When the snowball gets close, walk toward it rather than running away, then escape through the path Nunu & Willump came from. If hit by Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage, get out immediately before you are rooted afterward, and leave the range of Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero as well.

Poppy.build: Early on, buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps. Poppy deals mostly physical damage, and Karthus has relatively low armor, so build armor first. Get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier too since Poppy E Heroic Charge can catch you.
Poppy.combo: Place Karthus W Wall of Pain on Poppy's escape route, then drop Karthus Q Lay Waste where she is headed after crossing the wall. This uses Karthus W Wall of Pain's slow and magic resistance reduction in sequence. If a close fight breaks out, turn on Karthus E Defile and cast Karthus Q Lay Waste at Poppy's feet, then turn off Karthus E Defile when the fight ends.
Poppy.escape: Right after making Poppy use Poppy E Heroic Charge is your chance to close the distance. If Poppy R Keeper's Verdict charges, move sideways out of its path, then reposition after the knockback threat has passed. Karthus has no mobility spell to escape on his own, so don't engage while Poppy still has crowd control available.
Poppy.fight: Keep your distance and poke with Karthus Q Lay Waste while Poppy E Heroic Charge is available. In trades, target Poppy with Karthus Q Lay Waste when she isn't overlapping a minion to maximize its single-target damage. Close the distance right after Poppy uses Poppy E Heroic Charge, but account for her increased armor at low health and calculate your finishing damage before going in.
Poppy.laning: Avoid standing with a wall or narrow passage behind you to prevent the stun from Poppy E Heroic Charge. If Poppy's dropped shield from Poppy P Iron Ambassador is safe to step on, remove it first to prevent her from gaining a shield. Keep Karthus E Defile on only while Poppy is close, and turn it off as soon as she moves away to save mana.
Poppy.phase: Early on, Karthus is easy for Poppy E Heroic Charge to catch because he has no escape, so prioritize your distance and the terrain behind you. In the mid game, Karthus R Requiem and ability power core items let you affect the entire map. In late-game teamfights, use Karthus P Death Defied to keep dealing damage after you die.
Poppy.teamfight: Keep casting Karthus Q Lay Waste from the back, and use Karthus R Requiem from a safe position where Poppy E Heroic Charge or Poppy R Keeper's Verdict can't interrupt its channel. If the entire enemy frontline has engaged on your allies, turn on Karthus E Defile and move in to deal area damage. If you die, use Karthus E Defile and Karthus Q Lay Waste in Karthus P Death Defied's spirit form near the enemy team. If enemies have lost health and Karthus R Requiem is available, use it to finish them.
Poppy.watch: Poppy E Heroic Charge stuns you if it knocks you into a wall, so stand in open space with no wall behind you. If you get hit by the first strike of Poppy Q Hammer Shock, walk out of the zone before the second damage instance detonates. If you see Poppy R Keeper's Verdict begin charging, move sideways out of its path.

Rammus.build: Rammus deals mostly magic damage, and Karthus has relatively low magic resistance, so build Null-Magic Mantle first, then choose Mercury's Treads. Rammus can dive in and interrupt Karthus R Requiem, so get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier too. If Rammus E Frenzying Taunt makes it hard to protect your channel, fit in Banshee's Veil.
Rammus.combo: When Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl ends, place Karthus W Wall of Pain along his escape route, then cast Karthus Q Lay Waste where he will be after crossing the wall. If Rammus gets close, activate Karthus E Defile and cast Karthus Q Lay Waste underfoot, aiming for a spot that doesn't overlap with minions. Turn off Karthus E Defile as soon as distance opens up.
Rammus.escape: The window after Rammus R Soaring Slam is down is your chance to join a fight. Check that you can stay out of Rammus E Frenzying Taunt range, then use Karthus W Wall of Pain to help engage when an ally has already immobilized an enemy or the enemy has a long escape route.
Rammus.fight: Back off when Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active. Once it ends, lower his magic resistance with Karthus W Wall of Pain and focus your damage. When Rammus isn't overlapping with minions, hit only him with Karthus Q Lay Waste. Karthus has no escape ability, so don't approach while Rammus still has a way to engage.
Rammus.laning: Early on, stay behind the minion wave and manage your distance to block Rammus Q Powerball's approach. Keep Karthus E Defile active only while Rammus is close, then turn it off as soon as he moves away to save mana. Keep farming rather than forcing an engage, and join fights when an ally catches the enemy first.
Rammus.phase: Early on, Karthus has no escape, so be especially wary of Rammus closing in and focus on farming. In the mid game, use Karthus R Requiem and your ability power core items to affect the whole map. In late-game teamfights, Karthus P Death Defied lets you deal damage after dying, so position to die as late as possible.
Rammus.teamfight: Keep casting Karthus Q Lay Waste from the back, and don't start Karthus R Requiem while Rammus is close. Focus your damage after Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl ends. When all of the enemy frontline has engaged on your team, activate Karthus E Defile and go in. If you die, keep dealing damage with Karthus E Defile and Karthus Q Lay Waste from a spot that reaches the enemy team. If they have lost health and Karthus R Requiem is available, finish them from your spirit form.
Rammus.watch: When you see Rammus Q Powerball, put minions between you and him and create distance early. Rammus E Frenzying Taunt prevents movement and ability use, so fight outside its range. Anticipate the full area of Rammus R Soaring Slam after he rolls in quickly, then move away from the landing spot immediately.

RekSai.build: Rek'Sai deals mostly physical damage, and Karthus has low armor, so build armor first. Start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Rek'Sai can dive in, so get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier too.
RekSai.combo: Place Karthus W Wall of Pain on Rek'Sai's escape route, then cast Karthus Q Lay Waste where she'll be after crossing the wall. If Rek'Sai gets close, activate Karthus E Defile and cast Karthus Q Lay Waste underfoot. Turn off Karthus E Defile as soon as the fight ends.
RekSai.escape: After dodging the knockup from Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, you have a chance to respond. Don't chase in just because Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel is down. If Rek'Sai has also used R Void Rush and it has not come off cooldown yet, pressure her with Karthus W Wall of Pain and Karthus Q Lay Waste.
RekSai.fight: After dodging the knockup from Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, use Karthus W Wall of Pain to make her cross it and hit her with Karthus Q Lay Waste. Aim Karthus Q Lay Waste at Rek'Sai when she isn't overlapping with minions, and turn off Karthus E Defile when she moves away.
RekSai.laning: Early on, don't push the lane recklessly or walk alone through areas without vision. Step on visible entrances to Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel tunnels as you pass to destroy them. Try to gank when an ally has immobilized an enemy first or the enemy has pushed far up; otherwise, help your allies engage with Karthus W Wall of Pain.
RekSai.phase: Early on, Rek'Sai's ganks are threatening and Karthus has no escape, so focus on avoiding deaths. In the mid game, Karthus R Requiem and your ability power core items let you affect the whole map. In late-game teamfights, Karthus P Death Defied lets you deal damage after dying.
RekSai.teamfight: Keep casting Karthus Q Lay Waste from the back and position to die as late as possible. Rek'Sai can interrupt Karthus R Requiem with her engage, so cast it from a safe position. If all of the enemy frontline has engaged on your team, activate Karthus E Defile and go in for area damage. Even if you die, keep using Karthus E Defile and Karthus Q Lay Waste while Karthus P Death Defied is active inside the enemy team.
RekSai.watch: If Rek'Sai knocks you up with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, Karthus has no mobility to escape and is easy to catch. When Rek'Sai burrows, avoid walls and narrow paths and move into open space. Watch for her follow-up engage with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel and R Void Rush, and cast Karthus R Requiem from a safe position.

Rengar.build: Start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Rengar's main damage is physical, and Karthus has low armor, so build armor first. Rengar can leap in, so get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier too.
Rengar.combo: When Rengar W Battle Roar is down, place Karthus W Wall of Pain where Rengar will step. Then cast Karthus Q Lay Waste where he'll be after crossing the wall. While Rengar is close, activate Karthus E Defile and cast Karthus Q Lay Waste underfoot. Turn off Karthus E Defile as soon as the fight ends.
Rengar.escape: The chance to engage comes when you've dodged Rengar E Bola Strike, Rengar W Battle Roar is down, and his resource bar is empty. Rengar has no ability to create distance on his own, so if an ally catches him first, follow up with Karthus W Wall of Pain and Karthus Q Lay Waste.
Rengar.fight: Trade when Rengar's resource bar is empty and Rengar W Battle Roar is down. Place Karthus W Wall of Pain where Rengar will cross it to slow him and lower his magic resistance, then attack with Karthus Q Lay Waste. If Rengar gets close, activate Karthus E Defile, but turn it off as soon as he moves away.
Rengar.laning: Early on, avoid walking beside bushes when Rengar is out of sight and use a Control Ward to gain vision of them. When aiming Karthus Q Lay Waste at Rengar, target a spot that doesn't overlap with minions to maximize its single-target damage. Manage Karthus E Defile's mana cost and last-hit directly as Karthus.
Rengar.phase: Early on, Karthus has no escape, so be especially wary of Rengar's leap and stay away from bushes. From the mid game onward, Karthus R Requiem and your ability power core items let you affect the whole map, so time your ultimate from a safe position. In late-game teamfights, Karthus P Death Defied lets you deal damage after dying.
Rengar.teamfight: Stand behind your allied frontline and within your team's vision so they are the target of Rengar's leap when he engages with Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt. Keep casting Karthus Q Lay Waste from the back. After Rengar engages and uses Rengar W Battle Roar, slow him with Karthus W Wall of Pain and focus your damage. Even if you die, use Karthus E Defile and Karthus Q Lay Waste while Karthus P Death Defied is active, from near the enemy team. If they have lost health and Karthus R Requiem is available, cast it.
Rengar.watch: Near bushes, watch out for Rengar P Unseen Predator's leap, and avoid paths beside bushes when you can't see Rengar. When Rengar's resource bar is full, Rengar E Bola Strike can root you, so avoid trading. When Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt is active, don't walk alone; stay behind your allied frontline.

Sejuani.build: Build magic resistance first against Sejuani's main damage with Null-Magic Mantle, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Karthus has no mobility and is easy to hit with Sejuani's crowd control follow-up, so tenacity is also important. Get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier to prepare for being caught by Sejuani Q Arctic Assault.
Sejuani.combo: After Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is down, place Karthus W Wall of Pain on her escape route, then cast Karthus Q Lay Waste where she'll be as she crosses the wall. In close fights, activate Karthus E Defile and cast Karthus Q Lay Waste underfoot, aiming for a spot that doesn't overlap with minions. Turn off Karthus E Defile as soon as the enemy moves out of range.
Sejuani.escape: The moment after you make Sejuani use Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is your window to close the distance. After Sejuani E Permafrost stuns once, stacks can't build again for a short time, but her basic attacks deal bonus damage right after the stun, so create distance first. If Sejuani R Glacial Prison is also down, fight while slowing her escape with Karthus W Wall of Pain.
Sejuani.fight: Keep your distance while dodging Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and Sejuani R Glacial Prison. After Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is down, trade with Karthus W Wall of Pain on her escape route and Karthus Q Lay Waste. If Sejuani P Fury of the North has activated slow immunity, damage her first to give her armor time to wear off.
Sejuani.laning: Early on, Karthus has no escape, so watch Sejuani's approach paths and keep your distance. In the jungle, use Karthus Q Lay Waste where monsters overlap and activate Karthus E Defile to clear them, but don't force another camp if your mana drops below half. Gank when an ally has immobilized an enemy first or the enemy has pushed far up, leaving a long escape route.
Sejuani.phase: Early on, use jungle control and objectives to delay Sejuani's item timings while Karthus steadily clears camps and waves. In the mid game, use Karthus R Requiem and your ability power core items to affect the whole map. In the late game, Karthus P Death Defied lets you deal teamfight damage after dying.
Sejuani.teamfight: Keep casting Karthus Q Lay Waste from the back, dodging Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and Sejuani R Glacial Prison, and position to die as late as possible. Cast Karthus R Requiem from a safe position where your channel won't be interrupted. If the frontline, including Sejuani, has engaged on your team, activate Karthus E Defile for area damage. If you die inside the enemy team, keep using Karthus E Defile and Karthus Q Lay Waste while Karthus P Death Defied is active, and use Karthus R Requiem as well.
Sejuani.watch: Sejuani Q Arctic Assault charges in and knocks you up, while Sejuani R Glacial Prison stuns you, so dodge to the side when you see the tell. If you're hit by the first strike of Sejuani W Winter's Wrath, get out of range before the second strike, which deals more damage and slows. Sejuani E Permafrost stacks can also build from her melee allies' basic attacks, so create distance as soon as the indicator fills.

Shaco.build: Build magic resistance first against Shaco's main damage, starting with Null-Magic Mantle. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Shaco tends to dive onto Karthus, so get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier too.
Shaco.combo: Place Karthus W Wall of Pain on Shaco's escape route, then cast Karthus Q Lay Waste just beyond the wall. If Shaco gets close, activate Karthus E Defile and cast Karthus Q Lay Waste underfoot. Aim for Shaco when he isn't overlapping with other units, and turn off Karthus E Defile once distance opens up.
Shaco.escape: Shaco Q Deceive is his only mobility tool, so the moment he appears after using it is your chance to close the distance and catch him. Don't chase into paths without vision where you expect the fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box.
Shaco.fight: Karthus has no escape ability, so keep your distance while Shaco Q Deceive is available. When Shaco uses it to engage and reveals himself, focus your damage on him immediately with your allies. Cover the spot Shaco will cross with Karthus W Wall of Pain, then hit the slowed Shaco with Karthus Q Lay Waste.
Shaco.laning: Early on, maintain vision at your allied jungle entrances to prevent Shaco from ganking and invading. Karthus has no mobility or instant immobilize, so join a fight only when an ally has caught the enemy first or the enemy has pushed far up, leaving a long escape route. Otherwise, keep farming, and turn off Karthus E Defile as soon as the enemy moves out of range.
Shaco.phase: Early on, Shaco looks for an advantage through ganks and invades, and Karthus is easy to catch because he has no escape. If you avoid dying, keep vision up, and farm, Karthus R Requiem and your ability power core items let you affect the whole map in the mid game. In the late game, Shaco is weaker in one-on-one fights, while Karthus can still deal damage after dying.
Shaco.teamfight: Keep casting Karthus Q Lay Waste from the back and position somewhere Shaco can't interrupt the channel of Karthus R Requiem. When Shaco uses Shaco Q Deceive to engage and appears, attack immediately with your allies. Don't waste your damage on the clone from Shaco R Hallucinate; identify the real Shaco by how the health bars react. When the clone dies, move away from its explosion and fear. If Karthus P Death Defied activates, use Karthus E Defile and Karthus Q Lay Waste from a spot that reaches the enemy team, and cast Karthus R Requiem to finish them if you can.
