Shaco.watch: Shaco Q Deceive uses stealth and movement to get behind you for an empowered basic attack, so if he's nearby, keep your back to a wall or face your allies. Watch for the fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box in bushes without vision and around objectives; check with a Control Ward or Oracle Lens first. Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison deals more damage when your health is low, so don't retreat through paths where you have no vision.

Shyvana.build: Shyvana's main damage is magic, and Karthus has relatively low magic resistance, so buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Shyvana can dive in with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent, so get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier too. Shyvana Q Emberstrike also deals true damage, so resistances alone can't prevent all of her damage.
Shyvana.combo: Place Karthus W Wall of Pain where Shyvana must step on her escape route, then cast Karthus Q Lay Waste where the slowed Shyvana is heading. Shyvana has lower magic resistance after crossing the wall, so she takes more damage from Karthus Q Lay Waste. In close fights, activate Karthus E Defile and cast Karthus Q Lay Waste under Shyvana's feet, but turn off Karthus E Defile when she moves away.
Shyvana.escape: Don't try to stop Shyvana while she's flying with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent; slow her with Karthus W Wall of Pain after she lands. When Shyvana finishes transforming and returns to human form, her empowered state ends, so counterattack then. Shyvana has no ability to create distance on her own, giving you a chance to catch her, but Karthus can't immobilize her instantly alone, so time your attack with your allies' help.
Shyvana.fight: Shyvana is strongest when she's close, so keep your distance and poke with Karthus Q Lay Waste. When trading, aim at Shyvana when she isn't overlapping with minions to maximize Karthus Q Lay Waste's single-target damage. Right after Shyvana R Dragon's Descent brings her in, place Karthus W Wall of Pain where she lands and fight while creating distance.
Shyvana.laning: Pressure Shyvana early, before she builds stacks, but don't chase far because Karthus has no mobility or instant immobilize. Pressure her or start an objective when her Fury bar is empty; when it's full, don't hit an objective first while exposed. Turn off Karthus E Defile as soon as Shyvana leaves its range to save mana.
Shyvana.phase: From the mid game onward, Karthus R Requiem can affect fights elsewhere on the map. In the late game, Shyvana's permanent stacks from Shyvana P Scalemail make her harder to kill the same way, so Karthus should keep dealing damage from a safe position.
Shyvana.teamfight: Spread out with your allies so several of you aren't hit together by Shyvana R Dragon's Descent's path and area abilities. Keep casting Karthus Q Lay Waste from the back. If Shyvana has engaged on your allied frontline, activate Karthus E Defile for area damage. Even if you die, keep using Karthus E Defile and Karthus Q Lay Waste with Karthus P Death Defied active from near the enemy team, and use Karthus R Requiem when you can finish the channel.
Shyvana.watch: Shyvana R Dragon's Descent charges in and deals area damage, and she can't be stopped while flying. Watch for her engage when her Fury bar is full, then slow her with Karthus W Wall of Pain after she lands and create distance. Shyvana Q Emberstrike and Shyvana E Molten Burst deal damage based on maximum health, so don't stay in close combat for long.

Skarner.build: Build Null-Magic Mantle first and increase your magic resistance against Skarner's main damage; choose Mercury's Treads for boots. If you need to break the suppression from Skarner R Impale, decide in advance whether to include Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar in your build.
Skarner.combo: When Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down, place Karthus W Wall of Pain on his escape route, then cast Karthus Q Lay Waste where he'll be after crossing the wall. If Skarner stays close and the fight continues, keep Karthus E Defile active and cast Karthus Q Lay Waste underfoot. Turn off Karthus E Defile as soon as the fight ends.
Skarner.escape: The moment after you make Skarner use Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is your chance to close the distance or pick him off. Even then, don't enter the short suppression range first if Skarner R Impale is still available. Help your allies chase with Karthus W Wall of Pain when they've stopped Skarner from moving or his escape route is long.
Skarner.fight: Keep your distance while Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is available, and hit him with Karthus Q Lay Waste from the back. Right after Skarner uses his charge, place Karthus W Wall of Pain on his escape route and cast Karthus Q Lay Waste on the slowed target. If Skarner stays close after engaging on an ally, activate Karthus E Defile and cast Karthus Q Lay Waste underfoot, but turn off Karthus E Defile when he moves away.
Skarner.laning: When trading, aim Karthus Q Lay Waste at Skarner when he isn't overlapping with minions; when farming, use it where targets overlap. Keep Karthus E Defile active only while close to save mana, and last-hit directly as Karthus.
Skarner.phase: Early on, Karthus has no escape and is vulnerable to Skarner's charge and grab, so focus on farming and managing your distance. In the mid game, Karthus R Requiem and your ability power core items let you affect the whole map. In late-game teamfights, Karthus P Death Defied lets you deal damage after dying, but Skarner's damage and threat of catching you grow as he builds tank items.
Skarner.teamfight: Keep your distance from Skarner and his allies, cast Karthus Q Lay Waste from the back, and position to die as late as possible. Cast Karthus R Requiem from a safe position where Skarner can't interrupt the channel with his engage. If the entire frontline, including Skarner, has engaged on your team, use Karthus E Defile for area damage. Even if you die, keep using Karthus E Defile and Karthus Q Lay Waste while Karthus P Death Defied is active, from near the enemy team.
Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact charges through terrain, and you are stunned if he grabs you and collides with a wall, so don't stand with your back to a wall. Skarner R Impale suppresses you at short range and drags you away, so be especially careful when standing close to him or near the edge of an objective pit. Once he gets close, Skarner Q Shattered Earth / Upheaval's empowered basic attacks and Skarner P Threads of Vibration damage follow, so don't let him get into melee range.

Taliyah.build: Start with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Taliyah's main damage is magic, and Karthus has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Karthus has no mobility and is easy to hit with crowd control, so tenacity is also important.
Taliyah.combo: Place Karthus W Wall of Pain where Taliyah will cross it, then cast Karthus Q Lay Waste beyond the wall. Taliyah is slowed and has lower magic resistance after crossing the wall, making Karthus Q Lay Waste harder to dodge and more damaging. If she gets close, keep Karthus E Defile active and hit her with Karthus Q Lay Waste underfoot; turn off Karthus E Defile when the fight ends.
Taliyah.escape: Look for an opening after Taliyah W Seismic Shove and Taliyah E Unraveled Earth are down. If only Taliyah E Unraveled Earth is down, she can escape with Taliyah R Weaver's Wall, so especially look for an opening before Taliyah R Weaver's Wall comes back. Karthus has no escape ability, so don't force an approach while her crowd control is available.
Taliyah.fight: Keep your distance while dodging Taliyah E Unraveled Earth and Taliyah W Seismic Shove. When Taliyah crosses Karthus W Wall of Pain and is slowed, trade by casting Karthus Q Lay Waste where she isn't overlapping with minions. Activate Karthus E Defile only in close fights, and turn it off immediately when the enemy moves out of range.
Taliyah.laning: Early on, Karthus has no escape, so first secure enough distance to avoid Taliyah's crowd control. When clearing minions, hit overlapping targets with Karthus Q Lay Waste, and manage your mana by keeping Karthus E Defile active only as long as needed. If Taliyah disappears, she may affect another lane, so alert your allies and back off early.
Taliyah.phase: Early on, Karthus has no escape, so watch out for Taliyah's crowd control and quick rotations. In the mid game, Karthus R Requiem and your ability power core items let you affect the whole map. In the late game, Karthus P Death Defied lets you deal damage after dying, so position to die as late as possible in teamfights.
Taliyah.teamfight: Keep hitting with Karthus Q Lay Waste from the back, and cast Karthus R Requiem from a safe spot outside Taliyah's crowd control range. If the entire enemy frontline has engaged on your team, activate Karthus E Defile and dive in for area damage. If you die inside the enemy team, keep dealing damage with Karthus E Defile and Karthus Q Lay Waste while Karthus P Death Defied is active. If Karthus R Requiem is available and they have lost health, use it to finish them.
Taliyah.watch: Taliyah Q Threaded Volley can't change direction while being cast, so don't move in a straight line; sidestep it.

Udyr.build: Use Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Udyr deals mostly physical damage, and Karthus has relatively low armor, so build armor first. Move up Zhonya's Hourglass in your build because Udyr can close in with Udyr E Blazing Stampede.
Udyr.combo: Place Karthus W Wall of Pain where Udyr will pass, then cast Karthus Q Lay Waste along the path of the slowed Udyr. Udyr also loses magic resistance after passing through the wall. If a melee fight is unavoidable, keep Karthus E Defile on and cast Karthus Q Lay Waste at your feet; turn Karthus E Defile off once Udyr backs away.
Udyr.escape: The moment after Udyr uses Udyr E Blazing Stampede is your window to manage distance or counterattack. If Udyr E Blazing Stampede has stunned you once, use the window when it cannot immediately stun the same target again. Karthus has no mobility, so slow Udyr with Karthus W Wall of Pain placed where he will pass, then retreat.
Udyr.fight: Before Udyr approaches, chip away at his health with Karthus Q Lay Waste, aiming for spots that don't overlap with minions. Counterattack after Udyr W Iron Mantle's shield expires or after Udyr E Blazing Stampede stuns you once. Keep Karthus E Defile on only while Udyr is close, and turn it off as soon as you create distance.
Udyr.laning: Udyr appears from the jungle to gank, so place vision at key paths and jungle entrances. When Udyr is out of sight, don't move forward; farm with Karthus Q Lay Waste and Karthus E Defile. Keep Karthus E Defile on only while Udyr is close to save mana for the next fight.
Udyr.phase: Karthus has no escape early, so farm cautiously and watch especially for Udyr's ganks. In the mid game, Karthus can influence fights elsewhere with Karthus R Requiem and core ability power items. In late-game teamfights, Karthus can still deal damage after dying with Karthus P Death Defied.
Udyr.teamfight: Keep casting Karthus Q Lay Waste from the back, and target the vulnerable enemies behind Udyr instead of focusing only on the durable Udyr. If the enemy frontline, including Udyr, reaches your team, turn on Karthus E Defile and deal area damage. If you die, use Karthus E Defile and Karthus Q Lay Waste near the enemy team; if Karthus R Requiem is ready and enemies have lost health, cast it while in spirit form.
Udyr.watch: Udyr E Blazing Stampede closes the gap quickly and stuns, so create distance as soon as Udyr activates that stance. If Udyr gets close, also watch for Udyr Q Wilding Claw's empowered basic attacks and Udyr R Wingborne Storm's slow and area damage.

Vi.build: Vi's main damage is physical, and Karthus has relatively low armor, so use Cloth Armor to survive early and choose Plated Steelcaps. Move up Zhonya's Hourglass to prepare for Vi's engage.
Vi.combo: Place Karthus W Wall of Pain on Vi's escape route, then cast Karthus Q Lay Waste behind the slowed Vi. Aim for a spot that doesn't overlap with minions so only Vi is hit. If Vi gets close, turn on Karthus E Defile and cast Karthus Q Lay Waste at your feet; turn off Karthus E Defile once you create distance.
Vi.escape: The moment after dodging or baiting out Vi Q Vault Breaker is your chance to slow Vi with Karthus W Wall of Pain and manage your distance. If Vi R Cease and Desist is still ready, don't move forward alone; stay within range of your allies' protective abilities.
Vi.fight: Right after dodging Vi Q Vault Breaker, place Karthus W Wall of Pain along Vi's path and trade briefly with Karthus Q Lay Waste. Vi W Denting Blows reduces your armor with consecutive attacks and deals damage based on your max health, so don't fight at close range for long; create distance.
Vi.laning: Vi can approach with Vi P Blast Shield right after using an ability on a minion, so trade after the shield is gone. Karthus has no ability to escape on his own, so keep your distance. Only attempt a gank if an ally has already immobilized the enemy or the enemy has pushed in deep, leaving a long escape route.
Vi.phase: Early on, Karthus is easy to catch with Vi's engage because he has no escape, so focus on managing distance and building armor. In the mid game, Karthus can affect the whole map once Karthus R Requiem and core ability power items are ready. In late-game teamfights, Karthus can still deal damage after dying with Karthus P Death Defied.
Vi.teamfight: Keep casting Karthus Q Lay Waste from the back, and don't go out of vision alone while Vi R Cease and Desist is ready. Cast Karthus R Requiem from a safe spot where Vi's engage can't interrupt the channel. If you die, deal damage with Karthus E Defile and Karthus Q Lay Waste during Karthus P Death Defied; if Karthus R Requiem is ready and enemies have lost health, use it to finish them off.
Vi.watch: Vi Q Vault Breaker dashes in and knocks Karthus back, so move backward or sideways when you see Vi charging it. Vi R Cease and Desist chases its target all the way and applies a stun and knockup, so don't rely on Flash; stay within range of your allies' protective abilities.

Viego.build: Viego's main damage is physical, and Karthus has relatively low armor, so start with Cloth Armor to build armor first, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Move up Zhonya's Hourglass because Viego can close in with Viego W Spectral Maw and Viego R Heartbreaker. If a long duel makes the healing from Viego P Sovereign's Domination and Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King a problem, consider Grievous Wounds after building resistances.
Viego.combo: Place Karthus W Wall of Pain on Viego's escape route, then cast Karthus Q Lay Waste on Viego after he passes through the wall. If Viego gets close, turn on Karthus E Defile and cast Karthus Q Lay Waste at your feet; turn off Karthus E Defile once you create distance.
Viego.escape: After Viego W Spectral Maw is down, you have a chance to pressure him with Karthus W Wall of Pain and Karthus Q Lay Waste. However, Viego can reposition if Viego R Heartbreaker is still ready, so check both mobility abilities before engaging and especially look for an opening before Viego R Heartbreaker comes back up.
Viego.fight: After dodging the charge of Viego W Spectral Maw to the side, place Karthus W Wall of Pain where Viego will pass and hit him with Karthus Q Lay Waste. Aim Karthus Q Lay Waste so it hits only Viego, in a spot that doesn't overlap with minions.
Viego.laning: Early on, you're easy to catch with Viego's engage, so don't push the lane toward the direction where Viego E Harrowed Path is visible, and avoid that path or check it with a Control Ward. Join fights only if an ally has already immobilized the enemy or the enemy has pushed in deep, leaving a long escape route; otherwise, farm camps and waves. Keep Karthus E Defile on only while enemies are close, and turn it off as soon as they move away to save mana.
Viego.phase: Early on, Karthus has no escape, so watch for Viego's engage while farming camps and waves. In the mid game, Karthus can affect the whole map once Karthus R Requiem and core ability power items are ready. In late-game teamfights, Karthus can still deal damage after dying with Karthus P Death Defied, so fight from a position where you can survive as long as possible.
Viego.teamfight: Keep hitting enemies with Karthus Q Lay Waste from the back, and if an ally falls in front of Viego, move away from that spot so Viego can't possess them with Viego P Sovereign's Domination. If the entire enemy frontline reaches your team, turn on Karthus E Defile and deal area damage; even if you die, use Karthus P Death Defied near the enemy team. Cast Karthus R Requiem from a safe position where you can protect the channel, and if it's available in spirit form, use it to finish off the remaining enemies.
Viego.watch: Viego W Spectral Maw stuns for longer the more it is charged, so dodge to the side when you see Viego charging it. If Viego E Harrowed Path is visible on terrain, watch for a camouflaged Viego to engage and avoid that path. When your health is low, move back because you may be targeted by Viego R Heartbreaker.

Warwick.build: Build magic resistance first against Warwick's main damage. Buy Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Move up Zhonya's Hourglass to prepare for Warwick's engage, and consider Quicksilver Sash if you need to remove Warwick R Infinite Duress yourself.
Warwick.combo: After Warwick's fear triggers, place Karthus W Wall of Pain where Warwick will pass, then hit him with Karthus Q Lay Waste while he is slowed and has reduced magic resistance. If Warwick is already close, turn on Karthus E Defile and cast Karthus Q Lay Waste at his feet. Turn off Karthus E Defile as soon as Warwick leaves its range.
Warwick.escape: Don't engage just because Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast is down. Wait until Warwick R Infinite Duress is also down and Warwick E Primal Howl's fear has triggered before looking for an opening. Look to engage before Warwick R Infinite Duress comes back up.
Warwick.fight: Keep your distance and trade damage with Karthus Q Lay Waste instead of approaching Warwick first. Aim for Warwick when he isn't overlapping with minions to maximize single-target damage. Save your burst while Warwick E Primal Howl is active, then attack again after the fear triggers.
Warwick.laning: When your health drops below half, Warwick W Blood Hunt reveals your position and increases Warwick's movement and attack speed, so recall even if it means giving up some farm. Karthus has a hard time setting up ganks on his own, so join only if an ally has already immobilized the enemy or the enemy has a long escape route. Otherwise, farm waves and camps while managing Warwick's engage range.
Warwick.phase: Early on, Karthus has no escape, and giving Warwick a kill means constant pressure from Warwick W Blood Hunt, so focus on scaling safely. In the mid game, Karthus can affect the whole map with Karthus R Requiem and core ability power items. In late-game teamfights, Karthus can still deal damage after dying with Karthus P Death Defied.
Warwick.teamfight: Keep casting Karthus Q Lay Waste from the back and position yourself to die as late as possible. Warwick R Infinite Duress can interrupt Karthus R Requiem's channel, so cast it from a safe spot or when an ally can protect you. If you are going to die, use Karthus E Defile and Karthus Q Lay Waste in spirit form with Karthus P Death Defied near the enemies, then finish off enemies who have lost health with Karthus R Requiem.
Warwick.watch: If Warwick closes in with Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast, Karthus will have a hard time escaping on his own. While Warwick E Primal Howl is active, the damage he takes is reduced and fear follows, so back off and respond after the fear triggers. Warwick R Infinite Duress can engage and suppress you from a long distance, so don't assume an area without vision is a safe distance away.

XinZhao.build: Xin Zhao's main damage is physical, and Karthus has relatively low armor, so use Cloth Armor to survive early. Choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Move up Zhonya's Hourglass because it's hard to escape once Xin Zhao closes in with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge.
XinZhao.combo: Place Karthus W Wall of Pain where Xin Zhao must pass to escape, then cast Karthus Q Lay Waste on the other side of the wall. If Xin Zhao gets close, turn on Karthus E Defile and cast Karthus Q Lay Waste at your feet, aiming for a spot that doesn't overlap with minions. Turn off Karthus E Defile as soon as the fight ends.
XinZhao.escape: The moment after Xin Zhao uses Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is your chance to close the gap or pick him off. If Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike's third attack is still pending, get out of range first. If Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard is active, create distance and counterattack after the immunity ends.
XinZhao.fight: Keep your distance while Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is ready, and dodge the second thrust of Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning by moving sideways. Right after Xin Zhao uses Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge, place Karthus W Wall of Pain on his escape route and deal damage with Karthus Q Lay Waste. Keep Karthus E Defile on only while Xin Zhao is close, and turn it off as soon as he moves away.
XinZhao.laning: When farming, cast Karthus Q Lay Waste where minions overlap; when trading, target Xin Zhao where he doesn't overlap with minions. Don't leave Karthus E Defile on unnecessarily, and last-hit directly to restore mana.
XinZhao.phase: In the mid game, Karthus can affect the whole map with Karthus R Requiem and core ability power items, so check other lanes to choose when to use it. In late-game teamfights, use the moment Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends as a chance to counterattack, and Karthus can keep dealing damage with Karthus P Death Defied even after dying.
XinZhao.teamfight: Keep casting Karthus Q Lay Waste from the back and leave space between yourself and your allies to prepare for Xin Zhao's engage. Cast Karthus R Requiem from a safe position where Xin Zhao's engage can't interrupt the channel. Counterattack when Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard's immunity ends, and if you die, use Karthus E Defile and Karthus Q Lay Waste during Karthus P Death Defied.
XinZhao.watch: Move sideways to dodge the second thrust of Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning. If Xin Zhao has hit you twice with the empowered attacks from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike, Flash out of range before the third hit knocks you up. Damage from outside spear range does not work while Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard is active, so wait for the immunity to end.

Zac.build: Zac deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first. Use Null-Magic Mantle early to survive, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Move up Zhonya's Hourglass because Zac can jump in and grab Karthus.
Zac.combo: Place Karthus W Wall of Pain on Zac's escape route, then cast Karthus Q Lay Waste on Zac as he passes through the wall. In close fights, turn on Karthus E Defile and cast Karthus Q Lay Waste at your feet, aiming for a spot that doesn't overlap with other units. Turn off Karthus E Defile as soon as the fight ends.
Zac.escape: The moment after Zac E Elastic Slingshot is down is your chance to close the gap or pick Zac off. If Zac Q Stretching Strikes is also down, slow his path with Karthus W Wall of Pain and attack with Karthus Q Lay Waste.
Zac.fight: Keep your distance to avoid Zac E Elastic Slingshot and Zac Q Stretching Strikes, and create distance after Zac engages to avoid Zac W Unstable Matter's damage. When Zac E Elastic Slingshot is down, place Karthus W Wall of Pain where Zac will pass and hit him with Karthus Q Lay Waste. Turn on Karthus E Defile only when fighting at close range.
Zac.laning: When farming, cast Karthus Q Lay Waste where monsters or minions overlap, and keep Karthus E Defile on only as long as needed. Engage only if an ally has already caught the enemy or the enemy has pushed in deep, leaving a long escape route.
Zac.phase: In the mid game, Karthus can affect the whole map once Karthus R Requiem and core ability power items are ready. In late-game teamfights, Karthus can still deal damage after dying with Karthus P Death Defied.
Zac.teamfight: Keep casting Karthus Q Lay Waste from the back, and create distance if Zac engages to avoid Zac W Unstable Matter's damage. If the blobs from Zac P Cell Division approach, clear them with the area damage from Karthus Q Lay Waste or Karthus E Defile. Cast Karthus R Requiem from a safe position where Zac's engage can't interrupt the channel, and if you die near the enemy team, use your abilities during Karthus P Death Defied.
Zac.watch: Zac E Elastic Slingshot charges before dashing in and knocking you up, so if you see him charging from behind a wall, move away from where he will land. If Zac Q Stretching Strikes slows and knocks you up too, Karthus, who has no mobility, is easy to hit with follow-up attacks. Once Zac gets close, watch out for Zac W Unstable Matter, which deals damage based on your max health.
